If you want the **best online options**, the strongest picks from your results are **Jungian/structured shadow work courses** for depth, and **guided spiritual-practice courses** for meditation and integration.[3][10][12]

- **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** on Jung Platform — Best if you want a more psychologically grounded, Jung-informed approach to shadow work.[3]
- **Embracing The Shadow** with Charlie Morley on Awake Academy — A strong choice if you want shadow work tied to spiritual practice and contemplative exploration.[10]
- **Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth** on Insight Timer — Good for people who want a meditation-forward, self-healing style of practice.[12]
- **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** on Udemy — A practical, accessible option if you want a broad introductory course.[2]
- **Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises** from Centre of Excellence — Useful if you want a more structured, exercise-based program.[4]
- **Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course** from Courses for Success — Best if you want a certificate-style course with a more formal learning path.[5]

If you want a more curated starting point, the category roundup from Mind Is the Master also highlights several of these as top online shadow work courses, including the **Shadow Work Journal by ManTalks Training**.[1]

For a quick way to choose:
- **Deepest psychology-based learning:** Jung Platform.[3]
- **Most spiritual / contemplative:** Awake Academy or Insight Timer.[10][12]
- **Most beginner-friendly and practical:** Udemy options.[2][13][15][16]
- **Most structured / certificate-oriented:** Centre of Excellence or Courses for Success.[4][5]
